purpose: Bounded mechanism trial; no ten-client throughput or adoption claim
scenarios: clean tree: direct, Nx cache bypass, cold Nx, warm Nx
relevant source edit: build must miss
restored artifact: delete build output and repeat warm Nx
failed command and cancellation: failed/incomplete output must not be cached
dirty tree: Nx cache must be bypassed
acceptance: Expand only after a separate ten-mission replay proves at least 50% less total verification CPU per completed candidate, with fresh trust gates and unchanged coverage.
